name: copilot-cache-keeper
description: Warns before a Copilot chat's prompt cache expires; keep it warm or write a handoff summary.

commands.title: Cache Keeper: Manage chats in this window
Cache Keeper: Write handoff summary now
Cache Keeper: Show which chats are tracked (diagnostics)

cacheKeeper.warnSeconds.description: Warn this many seconds before the cache expires.

cacheKeeper.thresholdTokens.description: From this context size (in tokens) a chat is expensive to let expire, since its next message re-sends all of it at full price: an unanswered warning writes a handoff summary (if cacheKeeper.autoSummary is on and the model's price is known), and once expired the status bar turns orange. Counted in tokens so one value fits cheap and expensive models alike (100k is about 40 credits with Opus 5.5).

cacheKeeper.autoSummary.description: Above the threshold, write a handoff summary if nobody answers the warning (only when it and a new chat from it cost clearly less than continuing this chat cold).

enumDescriptions: 100%: never spend more than the expiry would have cost
cacheKeeper.autoKeepWarmCapPercent.description: Auto keep warm stops once its keep-alives, plus the closing handoff summary (when cacheKeeper.summaryAfterKeepWarm is on), would cost more than this share of what letting the cache expire would have added, priced when auto keep warm started.

cacheKeeper.summaryAfterKeepWarm.description: Write a handoff summary when keeping warm ends: before the expiry that follows a Keep warm once, and when auto keep warm reaches its cap, if it and a new chat from it cost clearly less than continuing this chat cold. Off: the cache just expires.

cacheKeeper.minCredits.description: Ignore chats where letting the cache expire would add less than this many credits: no listing, warnings, automatic actions or orange status for them. Applies on top of cacheKeeper.thresholdTokens.

cacheKeeper.ttlSeconds.description: Cache lifetime override per model id, in seconds, e.g. {"claude-opus-5.5": 300}. Otherwise: what the chat's own log says (Copilot SDK chats), else the newest value from Copilot CLI and Copilot SDK logs (all chats, Local included: same backend), else the longest pause after which a Local chat still hit the cache (only if longer than the default), else built-in defaults (Claude 300, Sol 6.1 1800, others 300). Learned and measured values older than cacheKeeper.lifetimeMaxAgeDays are not used.

cacheKeeper.keepAliveLeadSeconds.description: Send keep-alives this many seconds before the cache expires (all models). A keep-alive buys a full cache lifetime from when it is sent, so later is cheaper; too late risks missing it.

cacheKeeper.keepAliveJitterPercent.description: Vary when keep-alives go out (Keep warm and Auto keep warm), so they don't arrive on a fixed beat: each one is sent at a random point within +/- this share of the cache lifetime around a point that far ahead of cacheKeeper.keepAliveLeadSeconds. Never later than that lead, so the safety margin before expiry is kept. 5 with a 5 min cache: between 5 s and 35 s before expiry. 0 turns it off.

enumDescriptions: Put the chat where you last typed back into the Chat view; close the other tabs. Right as long as you type in the chat you are looking at.
Just close the tab. If the chat was in the Chat view, the view falls back to the sessions list.
Leave the tab open; nothing is moved or closed.
cacheKeeper.afterSend.description: What to do with the chat tab Cache Keeper opened to send a keep-alive or summary, once the reply is in. (VS Code does not tell extensions which chat the Chat view shows, so only where you last typed is known.)

cacheKeeper.expiredChats.description: How many expired chats the status-bar list keeps, most recently expired first (warm and working chats are always listed, as are the chat where you last typed and chats with a handoff summary ready). Only chats active within cacheKeeper.lookbackHours are read at all.

cacheKeeper.lookbackHours.description: Read chats whose log changed within this many hours. Older chats are not listed, even with a higher cacheKeeper.expiredChats.

cacheKeeper.lifetimeMaxAgeDays.description: Use cache lifetimes learned from Copilot CLI and Copilot SDK logs, and lifetimes measured in Local chats, only if they are at most this many days old. Copilot can change a lifetime server side, so older values are dropped and the next source applies (measured, then built-in default).
